subject: Full-loop: Julia Park — trellis sequencing & buffer plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily@talentbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Full-loop: Julia Park — trellis sequencing & buffer plan

Hi team,

We have Julia Park scheduled for a virtual full-loop next week (candidate in PST). Emily (TalentBridge) attached the resume and confirmed availability. I want to lock panel sequencing and buffer logic now so we can send a tidy invite to the candidate and avoid back-and-forth.

High-level constraints:
- Four interview slots (two technical, one product/PM-style, one hiring manager + culture).
- Total candidate-facing time: 3h (prefer 45/45/30/60 or similar with 15–20 min buffers between panels).
- Candidate prefers morning PST but flexible until early afternoon.
- We must preserve a 30-minute async debrief window for interviewers after final slot.

Proposed "trellis" sequencing (first draft):
1) 9:00–9:45 PST — System design deep-dive (eng tech lead)
2) 10:05–10:50 PST — Algorithm + scale (senior infra)
3) 11:10–11:40 PST — PM/product cross-functional (product lead)
4) 12:00–1:00 PST — Hiring manager + culture (hiring manager + recruiter)

Buffers: 20 minutes between 1/2 and 2/3, 20 minutes between 3/4. We can shorten to 15 min if panel availability is tight, but avoid <15.

Please reply with:
- Confirmed owners for each slot (I left generic roles above)
- Any hard constraints on 9:00 start or the 12:00 HM slot
- If you prefer a different order (we can swap PM earlier to reduce context switching)

Attachments: Julia_Park_Resume.pdf; Virtual_Fullloop_Runbook_v2.docx (runbook has debrief checklist, grading rubric, and candidate accommodations).

Thanks — want to send the invite to Julia by EOD if schedule looks good.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiting Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily@talentbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Full-loop: Julia Park — trellis sequencing & buffer plan

Laura — thanks for the clear plan. I can take slot 2 (Algorithm + scale). A couple of tweaks from my side:

- Can we flip slots 2 and 3? Having PM before the algorithm slot reduces the context-switch for the infra interviewer (we often see candidates introduce product tradeoffs that then inform the algorithm questions).
- If we flip, keep 20-minute buffers; that gives interviewers time to upload notes to the shared doc before the next session.

If Marissa is ok with the flip, I confirm slot owners: 1) Rishi (system design), 2) Marissa (PM/product), 3) Priyom (algorithms), 4) Laura (HM + culture).

I'll block tentative times on my calendar; please convert to a firm invite when we hear back from Marissa and Emily.

— Priyom
Engineering Manager, Infra

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily@talentbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Full-loop: Julia Park — trellis sequencing & buffer plan

+1 to flipping 2 and 3 — I can do the PM slot at 10:05, which matches my morning blocks. Two small asks:

- Can we make slot 1 (system design) 50 minutes and slot 4 (HM) 50 minutes instead of 45/60? Julia mentioned she likes slightly longer deep-dive time and shorter HM wrap-ups; 50/50 keeps total candidate minutes similar and eases my scheduling.
- Please include a 10-minute "quiet buffer" after slot 4 for interviewers to add notes; we also need the 30-minute async debrief as Laura mentioned.

Updated sequence suggestion (final draft):
1) 9:00–9:50 PST — System design (Rishi)
2) 10:05–10:50 PST — PM/product (Marissa)
3) 11:10–11:55 PST — Algorithms/scale (Priyom)
4) 12:15–1:05 PST — HM + culture (Laura)

Buffers: 15 minutes between 1/2 and 2/3, 20 minutes between 3/4; 10-minute quiet buffer after slot 4; 30-minute async debrief 1:20–1:50 PST.

I added a tentative calendar link here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=XYZ123-julia-fullloop — please do not send to the candidate until Emily confirms.

If everyone agrees, Laura, can you send the invite to Julia and cc Emily with accommodations and the runbook attached?

Thanks — Marissa
Staff PM

From: Emily Chen <emily@talentbridge.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Full-loop: Julia Park — trellis sequencing & buffer plan

Hi all — thanks for coordinating. Confirming on behalf of Julia: the updated sequence works for her. She prefers the 9:00 start and is comfortable with the buffer plan you laid out.

Julia also asked for two accommodations:
- A 10-minute breathing/break reminder in the invite before the HM slot (she gets audio fatigue on long panels).
- Captioning enabled on Zoom (she will join from a laptop with native caption support but wanted us to enable Live Captions).

I'll email Julia to confirm exactly once you send the firm invite. Calendar availability: she is confirming the 12:15–1:05 PST HM slot but flagged that anything later than 1:30 PST would be difficult.

Thanks — Emily (TalentBridge)
